name: Taiping Houkui Green Tea - Hand-Pressed Selection
marketing_tip: Unique long-leaf Taiping Houkui, known for its bold appearance and sweet, clean finish.
body: Taiping Houkui is one of China's most distinctive green teas. These hand-pressed leaves produce a clear, bright infusion with a lingering sweetness and a hint of wild orchid. A true connoisseur's tea.
